## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, as provided. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; broad sector participation and positive Consumer Discretionary, Materials, and Industrials performance are independent confirmations. Leadership: 3 sectors represented in the Top 5 (2/5 Consumer Discretionary, 2/5 Healthcare), neither Narrow nor Broad by the stated thresholds; style mixed, with Technology weakness limiting a stronger growth-style call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare is strong with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND; Materials also outperforms, with PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is the clear laggard: QCOM (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -9.50%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND. Communication is nearly flat on the week and negative for the month, with TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND; Energy is positive but trails most sectors at +0.41% for the week.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND; RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) ABOVE TREND; PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: 3 sectors (2/5 Consumer Discretionary, 2/5 Healthcare), neither Narrow nor Broad.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) BELOW TREND; BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with notable Industrial pressure as well.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND. TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION, while the mixed timeframes warrant monitoring rather than a strong trend call.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak: sector performance is -4.05% for the week and -6.51% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) are BELOW TREND; META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) is BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are positive but not leading, up 0.96% for the week and 4.15% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%), and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows strong sector performance, up 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and PFE (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +8.53%) are ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor relative strength in Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary, while monitoring Technology exposure given its negative sector trend. Style is mixed: cyclical and value-linked areas are participating, but Financials are positive rather than clear leaders and Technology weakness prevents a confirmed style call.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND and GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, if their recent momentum holds. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND, unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+3.45% 1W; +7.40% 1M) and Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M), within overall breadth of 10/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Technology (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M); Communication is also soft on a monthly basis (-1.22%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric price levels were not supplied, so price supports and resistance cannot be assessed. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, whether AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) in CORRECTION resumes its monthly advance, and whether GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND sustains its breakout momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+55): Q3 sales rose 39%, exceeding prior expectations; price action confirms the catalyst, with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND. Other high-scoring bullish headlines lack corresponding 1W/1M data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-45): Mixed analyst reactions followed weak guidance; price action confirms the negative tone, with INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND. Other bearish headlines lack corresponding 1W/1M data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, with 10/11 sectors positive and leadership spread across three sectors; style remains mixed rather than a confirmed Growth-versus-Value call. Relative strength is evident in LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND and GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor Technology weakness, especially INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND, alongside the CORRECTION patterns in AAPL and MSFT.
